title: Policy Drift Detector
description: Automated policy drift detection across five dimensions: missing metadata, missing authority citations, missing distractor explanations, identity anomalies, and readiness bypass attempts.

MISSING_METADATA.description: Detects questions with absent question_state, Difficulty, DifficultyScore, CognitiveLevel, Topic, or PrimaryCompetency fields
MISSING_METADATA.severity: HIGH when question_state is missing; MEDIUM otherwise

MISSING_CITATIONS.description: Detects ExplanationCorrect and ExplanationWrong fields lacking ASC, COSO, IFRS, GAAP, FASB, or IMA Statement references
MISSING_CITATIONS.severity: MEDIUM for ExplanationCorrect; LOW for ExplanationWrong
MISSING_CITATIONS.reference: CAQS_v1.0.md §4.3 — EV3: Correct answer must reference accounting principle by name

MISSING_EXPLANATIONS.description: Detects absent, empty, or boilerplate distractor ExplanationWrong fields. Covers DL-008, DL-018, DL-021, DL-025, DL-026, DL-013 defect patterns.
MISSING_EXPLANATIONS.severity: HIGH for DL-008/021/026; MEDIUM for DL-013; LOW for insufficient length
MISSING_EXPLANATIONS.reference: CAQS_v1.0.md §4.4; DEFECT_LIBRARY.md DL-008, DL-021, DL-026, DL-013

IDENTITY_ANOMALIES.description: Detects duplicate QuestionIDs, invalid CorrectChoice values, missing CorrectChoice, missing stems, and invalid question_state values
IDENTITY_ANOMALIES.severity: CRITICAL for missing/invalid CorrectChoice or Stem; HIGH for duplicates and invalid states

READINESS_BYPASS.description: Detects Certified items with insufficient ExplanationCorrect (<50 chars), missing distractor explanations, or high-difficulty items with short explanations (<200 chars)
READINESS_BYPASS.severity: HIGH for certified-without-explanation; LOW for short-explanation-on-high-difficulty

outputFormat.results: file-keyed object with per-dimension counts and severity summaries

options.--pack: Run against a single pack file
options.--threshold: Cap findings per dimension at N (default: unlimited)

integrationPoints: Pre-certification gate: run before any certification wave
Session audit: run at session startup to detect new drift
CI pipeline: drift count must not increase from baseline
